messages:
Lara: Quick heads-up — vendor (Vaultly) wants to go GA on the cloud marketplace but they need SSO + SCIM + HSM-backed KMS for key custody. We need to align cert rotation, SCIM attribute mapping, and the marketplace security checklist. Can security/platform/integrations weigh in?

Sam: I can take the KMS/HSM side. Two quick asks: do they expose a cert chain (PEM) for the HSM endpoint, and do they support KMIP or a cloud KMS adapter? Also need their key rotation policy.

Devon: I've got their cert chain, attaching the thumbprint in a private ticket. Heads-up — cert chain expires 2025-10-12. Marketplace requires either pinned thumbprint or automated rotation plan.

Ashley: For SAML/SCIM integration notes: vendor must provide SAML metadata (entityID + ACS). SCIM needs at minimum: emails, givenName, familyName, and groups. Typical SCIM mapping we use: userName -> email, name.givenName -> firstName, name.familyName -> lastName, roles -> groups.

Ashley: Example SAML snippet they can send (or upload metadata):

```
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://vaultly.example.com/saml">
  <SPSSODescriptor>
    <AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://redwood.example.com/saml/acs"/>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```

Ashley: And a small SCIM attribute mapping example we accept in the console: `[[{"scim":"userName","local":"email"}, {"scim":"name.givenName","local":"firstName"}]`]

Praveen: Important security items: 1) confirm HSM vendor supports non-exportable keys and customer-key-rotation without plaintext export; 2) get SOC2 or ISO report for the appliance; 3) marketplace requires a signed attestation for key custody model (bring-your-own-key vs vendor-managed). Also confirm their HSM CA rotation cadence and whether they can provide OCSP/CRL endpoints.

Lara: This is great. Can we do a quick 30m sync tomorrow 10am PT to nail the checklist and assign owners? @Praveen @Ashley @Devon @Sam

integrations-bot: Meeting created: "Marketplace: Vaultly SSO+HSM onboarding" — Tue 10:00 AM PT — Zoom link posted in private calendar. :calendar:

Sam: I'll draft the KMS acceptance checklist after the call and drop it in the partnership ticket. I'll include KMIP adapter verification steps and expected error codes to watch for.

Devon: I'll update the cert ticket with rotation steps and add a cron job sample to auto-check expiry. Quick sample check command: `openssl s_client -connect vaultly.example.com:443 -showcerts | openssl x509 -noout -enddate`

Lara: Perfect — thanks everyone. We'll run through the marketplace legal checklist during the call and confirm any additional compliance docs required. :thumbsup:
